dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, which is better for my trip, the black bag or the blue bag?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwɪtʃ ɪz ˈbɛtər fər maɪ ˈtrɪp, ðə ˈblæk ˈbæɡ ɔːr ðə ˈbluː ˈbæɡ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The black bag is cheaper, and it's as strong as the blue bag.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈblæk ˈbæɡ ɪz ˈtʃiːpər, ənd ɪts əz ˈstrɔːŋ əz ðə ˈbluː ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. And its weight is a problem. It's heavier.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪt ˈɪzənt. ənd ɪts ˈweɪt ɪz ə ˈprɑːbləm. ɪts ˈhɛviər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh. I don't want a heavy bag.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈwɑːnt ə ˈhɛvi ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Then take the blue bag. It's more useful, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈðɛn ˈteɪk ðə ˈbluː ˈbæɡ. ɪts ˈmɔːr ˈjuːsfəl, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: But it isn't as cheap as the black bag.
dialogue.reading: bʌt ɪt ˈɪzənt əz ˈtʃiːp əz ðə ˈblæk ˈbæɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's right. But good quality is never cheap!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈraɪt. bʌt ˈɡʊd ˈkwɑːləti ɪz ˈnɛvər ˈtʃiːp!
